tools.name: explain_rejection
tools.description: Paste an App Store or Google Play rejection message and get, for each guideline, ITMS code or Play policy it cites: what it means, what to change, and the related automated checks. Nothing is stored.

tools.name: explain_guideline
tools.description: Explain a single App Store Review Guideline (e.g. "4.2", "2.5.19", "5.1.1(v)"), an ITMS upload error ("ITMS-91053") or a Google Play policy name ("Data safety section"). Use it when there is no full rejection message.

tools.name: list_common_rejections
tools.description: List the App Store guidelines, ITMS codes and Google Play policies this server has a plain-English guide for.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: explain_rejection · Public sink: explain_guideline.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: explain_rejection · Public sink: explain_guideline

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
